Name: Gremory
Front Side: If you control 4 tokens: Deal +2 damage during combat
Ultimate Side: You Basic Emblem is still active and usable. Instead of only applying to Tier I units, now all Tier Units can be replaced by Rose Units. Each Rose Unit in the Exhaust Zone adds to the total damage when damage is dealt to the enemy goalie. After a goal remove all Rose Units and return the previous Units that were traded in.

Name: Zepar
Ultimate Side: You Basic Emblem is still active and usable. When a Swan Unit attacks an enemy Unit, transform it into a Swan Unit as well, it loses all other creature types during combat. Give the enemy unit -2 Power during combat.

Name: Sallos
Front Side: Always counts as defending. Deal 1 damage to the enemy goalie
Ultimate Side: You Basic Emblem is still active and usable. When an enemy Unit that has been marked by a song, if they have two song counters: they lose 1 power during combat. If they have three song counters: Deal 3 damage to the enemy goalie. Then it loses all counters.

Name: Belphegor
Front Side: If this has a burn counter + shooting at goal: Deal +2 damage to goalie
Ultimate Side:
Rauhnacht-Feuergeister get +1 Attack Power during combat for each victory counter.

Name: Flauros
Front Side: Reveal a unit from your exhaust zone. Give this unit +1 damage during combat if the revealed card was fire
Ultimate Side:
Create a permanent weapon token for one Star Unit. The weapons attack is the strongest fused unit.  
Break up all fused units and send them to the exhaust zone.

Name: Buer
Front Side: This unit has attack equal to the victory counters you have. Remove 1 victory counter.
Ultimate Side:
Give the permanent Teufel Mask counter on a unit in the field zone and change its unit type to basic. 
When the unit is in combat, it obtains the Rauhnacht-Feuergeister unit type, and +1 Attack Power each counter on the Teufel Mask. 
After each combat give the unit with Teufel Mask - 1 Attack Power during combat. 
After the unit deals - 1 Attack Power during combat remove the Teufel Mask and return its unit type.
